name: NeRF-Casting Reflection Model
definition: A method to render specular appearance by modeling accurate detailed reflections without expensive MLP evaluations, casting a small number of reflected rays, and minimizing computation at each point.
summary: NeRF-Casting models specular reflections by casting reflected rays through a volume representation and using a lightweight decoder, distinguishing itself by approximating the reflection cone via a von Mises-Fisher distribution.
